name: Westfall Stew
summary: Westfall Stew begins as a neighborly exchange between fleeing homesteaders and the few farmers still holding ground. With her family forced to abandon their land due to rampant banditry, Verna Furlbrow passes her cherished local recipe to Salma Saldean before departing the region.

sections.title: A Recipe Passed On
sections.body: The Furlbrows' departure highlights the worsening collapse across Westfall's countryside. Driven off their family acreage by Defias thieves and mechanical harvest reapers gone wild, Verna and Farmer Furlbrow are packing their wagon to seek refuge behind Stormwind's walls. Reluctant to let her home-cooked tradition vanish along with her farm, Verna entrusts her signature recipe for Westfall Stew to her neighbor, Salma Saldean.

sections.title: Homestead Solidarity
sections.body: Salma Saldean still clings to her homestead just down the road, stubbornly holding out alongside her husband Farmer Saldean. Receiving Verna's recipe is a bittersweet moment: while it marks the loss of another neighbor to the growing unrest, it also preserves a staple of local farm life. With the instructions in hand, Salma sets out to gather the necessary rustic ingredients to feed those still struggling to survive on the frontier.

faq.q: Why are the Furlbrows leaving their farm?
faq.answer: Thieves and bandits have overrun their fields, turning their land far too dangerous to work. Verna and Farmer Furlbrow are repairing their wagon to flee to the safety of Stormwind City.

Salma Saldean is a Westfall homesteader living on Saldean's Farm, just past the fork in the road from the Furlbrow homestead. She and her family continue to work their land despite the surrounding lawlessness.
It is a traditional, hearty regional dish concocted from native ingredients found across the Westfall plains, long shared among local farming households.

faq.q: Where are the Furlbrows planning to go?
faq.answer: They are heading north toward the safety of Stormwind City, where Verna's friends believe she will fit right in.
Saldean's Farm lies just beyond the fork in the main road, situated south of the Furlbrow pumpkin patch in Westfall.

faq.q: Does this quest reward the actual cooking recipe?
aliases: do i get westfall stew recipe
faq.answer: Delivering the written instructions to Salma Saldean is only the first step. To actually prepare the dish, Salma will ask for help sourcing the rustic ingredients needed for the pot.

angles.text: The dish represents the quintessential frontier cooking of human homesteaders, turning scavenged prairie game and hardy root vegetables into sustenance.
The delivery reflects the crumbling frontier of the kingdom of Stormwind, where ordinary rural citizens are steadily driven from their ancestral farms into urban exile.
